SELECT T.* FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD T
AND DATE_FORMAT(T.UPTIME, '%Y') = #{year} AND DATE_FORMAT(T.DOWNTIME, '%Y') = #{year}
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT R.EQUIPTCATEGORY, SUM(R.USAGETIME) AS USAGETIME, SUM(E.PLANUSETIME) AS PLANUSETIME FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD R, T_CORE_EQUIPT E
R.EQUIPTID = E.ID
AND R.EQUIPTCATEGORY = #{equiptCategory}
AND R.UPTIME > STR_TO_DATE (#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND R.DOWNTIME < STR_TO_DATE (#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
GROUP BY R.EQUIPTCATEGORY

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(R.UPTIME, '%Y-%m') AS UPTIME, SUM(R.USAGETIME) AS USAGETIME, SUM(E.PLANUSETIME) AS PLANUSETIME FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD R, T_CORE_EQUIPT E WHERE R.EQUIPTID = E.ID GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(R.UPTIME, '%Y-%m')
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(R.UPTIME, '%Y-%m') AS UPTIME, SUM(R.AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD R GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(R.UPTIME, '%Y-%m')

SELECT R.EQUIPTNAME, R.EQUIPTCATEGORY, R.USAGETIME, DATE_FORMAT(R.UPTIME, '%Y-%m') AS "YEARMONTH", E.PLANUSETIME FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD R, T_CORE_EQUIPT E
R.EQUIPTID = E.ID
AND R.EQUIPTNAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{equiptName},'%')
AND R.EQUIPTCATEGORY LIKE CONCAT('%',#{equiptCategory},'%')
AND DATE_FORMAT(R.UPTIME, '%Y-%m') = #{date}

SELECT T.EQUIPTNAME, T.EQUIPTCATEGORY, T.SAMPLEQTY, T.ORDERTASKQTY, T.AMOUNT, DATE_FORMAT(T.UPTIME, '%Y-%m') AS "YEARMONTH" FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD T
AND DATE_FORMAT(T.UPTIME, '%Y-%m') = #{date}
